milestones.name: Reset to first frame
milestones.summary: Static generation covers all 2273 identities in the compact reset-to-visible corpus, including 15 executable S-CPU WRAM identities decoded from private witnesses. The first-frame runtime executes 254 identities; a clean-BWRAM route-only sweep finds that 24 of a supplied 102-edge NMI schedule reach the post-route inventory checkpoint after 1433720 whole blocks with all 2273 identities dispatched at live S-CPU $00002C / SA-1 $00A6E7 endpoints. The full schedule intentionally fails closed with timing_debt when 78 later signals remain; this closes the compact route corpus, not whole-game parity.

blockers.summary: The compact reset-to-visible corpus contains 2273 identities and 2440 edges, and static generation covers all 2273. A clean-BWRAM private route sweep reaches its inventory checkpoint after 1433720 whole blocks with 2273/2273 identities dispatched and live S-CPU $00002C / SA-1 $00A6E7 endpoints. The full 102-edge schedule processes a decisive 24 signals and then fails closed with timing_debt while 78 later signals remain unscheduled; exact post-route causal parity is the active blocker, not static coverage.

Cooperative reset/MVN and post-reset SA-1 scheduling reach the first frame; reset-DMA side effects and PPU parity are exact, and CPU/S-CPU/SA-1/DMA counts match. The remaining work is the post-frame CPU/SA-1 upload handshake, one trailing SPC acknowledgement, and ordered digest parity.
